name: Southern Woodcraft, LLC
old_description: Handmade hardwood cabinets, vanities, wine rooms, closets, and more.
about:
Southern Woodcraft, LLC operates from Bluffton, South Carolina, where it produces custom hardwood cabinetry and millwork for residential clients. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The shop specializes in handmade hardwood cabinets, vanities, wine rooms, and closets, along with custom furniture and built-ins. Its finish carpentry division handles trim work, stair railings, wainscoting, and custom millwork. All pieces are built to order using solid hardwood rather than particle board, and the company emphasizes a personalized design process from consultation through installation.

Southern Woodcraft serves homeowners in the Bluffton area and surrounding Lowcountry region, providing tailored solutions for kitchen and bath remodels, custom storage, and architectural woodwork. The company works directly with clients rather than through contractors, offering free quotes and collaborative design.

The business was founded on a reaction against mass-produced, low-quality cabinetry; its stated mission is to deliver lasting craftsmanship and materials that outperform typical particle-board construction. By focusing on one-on-one client relationships, the firm aims to align each project with the homeowner's style, budget, and timeline.
